items.title: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
items.summary: Several prominent AI researchers, including Google's Jeff Dean, are reportedly departing to establish a new startup, signaling a significant shift in the competitive AI landscape.

items.title: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases
items.summary: Meta has introduced Muse Code, a new AI agent designed to assist developers in navigating and managing extensive codebases, potentially streamlining software development workflows.

items.title: Google just redesigned the search box for the first time in 25 years — here’s why it matters more than you think.
items.summary: Google has unveiled its first search box redesign in 25 years, indicating a deeper integration of AI-powered features that could fundamentally change user interaction with search.

items.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
items.summary: Google's Gemini API is expanding its Managed Agents capabilities with new features like 3.6 Flash and hooks, enhancing developer control and performance for AI agent deployment.

items.title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
items.summary: AURORA-LM introduces a novel autoencoding unified representation for continuous-latent diffusion language modeling, achieving high engagement for its potential in advanced language generation.

items.title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
items.summary: Video-DeepResearch proposes a multimodal deep research agent that integrates video analysis, aiming to revolutionize how AI assists in complex information gathering and synthesis.

items.title: 5 ways AI Mode in Search helps you enjoy the real world
items.summary: Google highlights five ways its new AI Mode in Search can enhance real-world experiences, suggesting a shift towards practical, context-aware AI assistance.

items.title: ToolArtist: Tool-Using Unified Multimodal Models for Agentic Image Generation
items.summary: ToolArtist presents a framework for unified multimodal models that leverage external tools for agentic image generation, pushing the boundaries of creative AI applications.

items.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
items.summary: PAST-Bench introduces a new benchmark for evaluating the foundational capabilities of recursive self-improvement in personal AI agents, crucial for developing more autonomous systems.

items.title: The Review Tax: Why 81% of Developers Are Buried in AI Code Review
items.summary: A new report reveals that 81% of developers are overwhelmed by the 'review tax' of AI-generated code, highlighting challenges in integrating AI into software development workflows.

items.title: The Personalization Mirage: How LLMs Fabricate User Profiles, and Why Self-Monitoring Misleads
items.summary: This research explores how LLMs can fabricate user profiles and how their self-monitoring mechanisms can be misleading, raising concerns about privacy and accuracy in personalized AI experiences.

items.title: OmniPack: Unified Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
items.summary: OmniPack proposes a unified token compression method to enhance the efficiency of omni-modal large language models, addressing computational demands for processing diverse data types.

items.title: Introducing Kiro Crew: AWS's Open-Source AI Agent Orchestrator
items.summary: AWS has launched Kiro Crew, an open-source orchestrator for AI agents, providing developers with tools to manage and coordinate complex agent-based applications.

items.title: Towards Physics of Multimodal Pretraining: Knowledge Flow, Modality Synergy, Early Unification, and Recipes
items.summary: This paper delves into the fundamental physics of multimodal pretraining, exploring knowledge flow, modality synergy, and early unification strategies to improve AI models.

items.title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: LLaDA MoE v2 introduces advancements in scaling Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) diffusion language models, promising more efficient and powerful large-scale AI systems.
